ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: the apprentice's masterwork
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: A keen crafter, artist or builder learns at a master's elbow until the master's eye finds nothing more to say, then sets out to make something excellent.

plain.li: Watched {OTHER_nameDef} at work all afternoon. {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't waste a single movement. I waste most of mine.
{OTHER_nameDef} let me hand over the tools today. I got two of them wrong.
I want to be as good at {SKILL} as {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm a long way off.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is a patient teacher. More patient than I deserve, some days.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} said my last piece was "not terrible". I've been grinning about it since breakfast.

gloomy.li: Next to {OTHER_nameDef}'s work, mine looks like a child made it.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} knows things about {SKILL} that I want. I intend to take every one of them.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} hands {OTHER_nameDef} the tools now, and is learning {SKILL} by watching every move {OTHER_pronoun} makes.

plain.li: I'm getting better. My hands know things now that my head doesn't. Next I want {OTHER_nameDef} to look at my work properly.
Made three pieces this week and threw two of them out. The third I'm keeping to show {OTHER_nameDef}.

warm.li: I'm not ashamed of my work any more. I'd like {OTHER_nameDef} to see it.

blunt.li: Getting there. {OTHER_nameDef} can tell me what's wrong with it.

cheerful.li: My joins are tighter and my edges are straighter. {OTHER_nameDef} has to see this!

gloomy.li: I'm better than I was. {OTHER_nameDef} will still find a hundred things wrong.

cold.li: My work has improved measurably. {OTHER_nameDef}'s assessment is the next step.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} is getting better at {SKILL}. {OTHER_nameDef} has stopped standing over {PAWN_objective} while {PAWN_pronoun} works.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} went over my work with me, every flaw of it, then said one thing that changed how I hold the tool. I'm making something now. Something good.
I've started on a piece I've had in my head for weeks. I'm not letting anyone see it until it's done.
[arcskill:Construction] I've measured the spot three times. Whatever I build there is going to stand straight for a hundred years.
[arcskill:Artistic] Picked the stone today. Turned it in the light most of the morning, and I can already see what's inside it.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} told me I'm ready. I don't know if I believe {OTHER_objective}, but I'm going to try.

blunt.li: Starting the real thing. Leave me alone at the bench.

cheerful.li: I have an idea and it's a good one. My hands can hardly keep up with it.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} thinks I can make something fine. If it comes out badly, I'll have let {OTHER_objective} down.

cold.li: I am ready to produce something worth keeping. I will not accept less.

chronicle.li: Something is taking shape under {PAWN_nameDef}'s hands, and {PAWN_pronoun} won't let anyone see it yet, not even {PAWN_possessive} teacher.

plain.li: Finished it. {OTHER_nameDef} looked at it for a long time, turned it over, and couldn't find anything to say. That's never happened.
It's the best thing I've ever made. I keep going back to look at it, in case it's changed.

warm.li: I showed {OTHER_nameDef} the piece. {OTHER_nameDef} put a hand on my shoulder and kept it there.

blunt.li: Made something good. Really good. {OTHER_nameDef} says so too.

cheerful.li: I made a beautiful thing, me, with these two hands!

gloomy.li: It's good. I don't know if I can ever do it again.

cold.li: I have made something excellent. It is the standard I'll hold myself to now.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} made a piece today I couldn't find fault with. I looked hard. I'm proud of {OTHER_objective}.
The piece {OTHER_nameDef} made is better than anything I made at that age. I told {OTHER_objective} so, eventually.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} finished the piece at last. {OTHER_nameDef} has been showing it to people.
The apprentice {PAWN_nameDef} has made the best piece of {PAWN_possessive} life.

plain.li: [timeout] The piece won't come right. I've put it away under a sack. Maybe I'm not ready.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} is dead. I'll never know what {OTHER_pronoun} would have thought of my best work.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has gone. I'll have to find the rest of {SKILL} on my own.
I've gone as far as I can with {OTHER_nameDef}. The rest can wait.

warm.li: [timeout] My best piece is still somewhere ahead of me. {OTHER_nameDef} says I'll get there.

blunt.li: [timeout] Can't get it right. Putting it down.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The big piece will have to wait. I've still got a lot to learn, and I like learning it.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I've stared at the half-finished piece for days. It stares back.

cold.li: [timeout] The work isn't ready, and neither am I. I'll return to it when the conditions improve.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} died before {PAWN_nameDef} could show {OTHER_objective} {PAWN_possessive} best work.
{PAWN_nameDef}'s best piece will have to wait.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was going to be good. Really good. I'd seen the start of it.
The piece {OTHER_nameDef} was making is still on the bench, half done. I can't bring myself to move it.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: a calling
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: A child or a teenager keeps turning up wherever a grown-up is good at something, asks a hundred questions, practices, and finds the work they want to do with their life.

li.label: a spark
li.waiting: Next: {PAWN_nameDef} works up the nerve to ask {OTHER_nameDef} about it.

plain.li: [child] I watched {OTHER_nameDef} doing {SKILL} today. I want to do that.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} let me hold the tools. They're heavy. I didn't drop any.
I keep ending up wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is working. I like watching how {OTHER_pronoun} does it.
[teen] The grown-ups keep asking what I want to do with myself. I think I might know.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} didn't shoo me away. {OTHER_nameDef} showed me instead.

cheerful.li: [child] I think {SKILL} is the best thing there is! {OTHER_nameDef} said I can watch again tomorrow.

gloomy.li: I'm probably no good at {SKILL}. I'd still like to try.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the best at {SKILL} here. I'm going to learn from the best.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} keeps following me around while I work. I don't mind. I was the same, once.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has been turning up wherever {OTHER_nameDef} works, and sitting just out of the way to watch.
Young {PAWN_nameDef} has taken an interest in {SKILL}.

plain.li: [child] I asked {OTHER_nameDef} a hundred questions. {OTHER_nameDef} answered ninety of them.
{OTHER_nameDef} said I can help, if I listen. I'm listening.
[teen] {OTHER_nameDef} showed me the basics today. It's harder than it looks. I like that it's hard.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} takes me seriously. Not many grown-ups do.

cheerful.li: [child] I helped! {OTHER_nameDef} said I did a real job and not a pretend one.

gloomy.li: I made a mess of it today. {OTHER_nameDef} said everyone does at first.

cold.li: I am learning faster than {OTHER_nameDef} expected. I saw it on {OTHER_possessive} face.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked me about {SKILL} all through supper. I'd forgotten what that kind of hunger looks like.
Let {OTHER_nameDef} try {SKILL} today. Hopeless and very determined. I liked {OTHER_objective} for it.

chronicle.li: Worn down by questions, {OTHER_nameDef} has started showing {PAWN_nameDef} the beginnings of {SKILL}.

plain.li: [child] I practiced every day this week. Even when I wanted to play.
My hands are getting the hang of it. {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't have to fix my mistakes as often.

warm.li: I love this. I didn't know you could love a kind of work.

cheerful.li: I'm getting good at {SKILL}. Not {OTHER_nameDef} good, but good!

gloomy.li: It's slow. Everything's slow when you're young.

cold.li: Progress is steady. At this rate I will surpass my teacher in a few years.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} practices {SKILL} in every spare hour now, and gets up early for more.

plain.li: [child] When I grow up I'm going to do {SKILL}. I've decided. {OTHER_nameDef} says it's a good choice.
I know what I want to do with my life. It's {SKILL}. It's always going to be {SKILL}.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} gave me a calling. I'll make {OTHER_objective} proud of it.

blunt.li: My trade is going to be {SKILL}. Decided.

cheerful.li: I found the thing I'm for. It's {SKILL}!

gloomy.li: I've found what I want to do. I hope the world leaves me time to do it.

cold.li: I have chosen my path: {SKILL}. The decision is final.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has the makings of a real hand at {SKILL}. I'll keep teaching as long as {OTHER_pronoun} keeps asking.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} knows what {PAWN_pronoun} wants to do with {PAWN_possessive} life, and it is {SKILL}.

plain.li: [timeout,child] I don't really want to do {SKILL} any more. I want to do something else. I haven't decided what.
[timeout] I've lost the taste for {SKILL}. {OTHER_nameDef} was nice about it.
[otherdead] {OTHER_nameDef} was teaching me. Now I'll have to work it out without {OTHER_objective}.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} left. I keep going to the place where {OTHER_pronoun} used to work.
Maybe {SKILL} isn't for me after all.

warm.li: [timeout] {OTHER_nameDef} was patient with me. I'm sorry it didn't stick.

cheerful.li: [timeout] I'm going to try something else next. Maybe everything else.

gloomy.li: [timeout] I thought {SKILL} was my thing. Maybe I don't have a thing.

cold.li: [timeout] The work doesn't suit me. Better to know now.

fizzleChronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has lost interest in {SKILL} and moved on to something else.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to learn {SKILL} more than anything. I was teaching {OTHER_objective}. I was enjoying it.
{OTHER_nameDef} was so young, and had just found the thing {OTHER_pronoun} loved.

ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.label: passing it on
ColonyCouncil.ArcDef.summary: An elder, or one of the colony's old hands, picks out someone younger to inherit their craft, teaches them until they're nearly as good, and hands down the last lessons.

plain.li: [elder] My hands aren't what they were. Everything I know about {SKILL} is in my head, and my head won't last forever.
[oldhand] I've been here longer than nearly anyone. If I go, everything I've learned about {SKILL} goes with me.
Watched {OTHER_nameDef} work today. Clumsy, and the right sort of stubborn. {OTHER_nameDef} could learn this.

warm.li: I'd like to pass on what I know to someone who'll care for it. {OTHER_nameDef}, maybe.

blunt.li: Somebody should learn {SKILL} properly before I'm gone. {OTHER_nameDef} will do.

cheerful.li: I've picked out an apprentice! Now to find out if {OTHER_nameDef} wants to be picked.

gloomy.li: I won't live forever out here. {OTHER_nameDef} had better learn what I know while there's time.

cold.li: My knowledge of {SKILL} is an asset to the colony. It should not be buried with me.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has been watching {OTHER_nameDef} work, with an eye to teaching {OTHER_objective} {SKILL}.
[elder] Old {PAWN_nameDef} is thinking about who will carry on {PAWN_possessive} craft.

plain.li: Asked {OTHER_nameDef} if {OTHER_pronoun} wanted to learn. {OTHER_nameDef} said yes before I'd finished asking.
First lesson with {OTHER_nameDef} today. We started with how to stand. {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to start with everything else.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is a good student. Reminds me of me, before I knew how much I didn't know.

cheerful.li: I have a student! I'd forgotten how much I like explaining things.

gloomy.li: I'm teaching {OTHER_nameDef}. I hope there's time to teach all of it.

cold.li: Instruction has begun. {OTHER_nameDef} is adequate material.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has offered to teach me {SKILL}. Everything {OTHER_pronoun} knows. I don't know what I did to deserve it.
Lessons with {OTHER_nameDef} every morning. {OTHER_nameDef} is strict, and right about nearly everything.

chronicle.li: Mornings now, {PAWN_nameDef} teaches {OTHER_nameDef} {SKILL}, from the beginning and with no shortcuts.

li.label: the last lessons
li.waiting: Next: the last lessons, the ones that aren't written down anywhere.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is good now. Not as good as me, but on the way. There are a few things left I haven't told {OTHER_objective}.
Caught {OTHER_nameDef} fixing a mistake before I could point it out. That's when you know.

warm.li: Watching {OTHER_nameDef} work is like watching myself years ago, only with better habits.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s nearly there. A few more things.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} corrected me today, and was right!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} won't need me much longer. I keep finding small things to correct.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has taken in most of what I can give. The rest is the hard part.

chronicle.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has come a long way under {PAWN_nameDef}'s teaching. There isn't much left to tell {OTHER_objective}.

plain.li: Gave {OTHER_nameDef} my old tools today. {OTHER_nameDef} held them as if they might break. They won't. They've been through worse.
{OTHER_nameDef} knows what I know now, more or less. The rest {OTHER_pronoun}'ll find out alone, the way I did.

warm.li: Whatever happens to me, what I know is safe with {OTHER_nameDef}. I slept well last night.

cheerful.li: My student is a master now! Well, nearly. Give it a year.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't need me any more. I'm glad, and sorry, both.

cold.li: The transfer is complete. My knowledge will outlast me. That was the objective.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} gave me {OTHER_possessive} old tools today. I don't think I've ever been given anything that mattered more.
Everything I know about {SKILL}, I learned from {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm going to say so to everyone who asks.

chronicle.li: {PAWN_nameDef} has handed down the last of what {PAWN_pronoun} knows of {SKILL}, and {OTHER_nameDef} has it all now.

plain.li: [otherdead] I was teaching {OTHER_nameDef}. All of it is still in my head, with nowhere to go.
[otherleft] {OTHER_nameDef} has left, half taught. I hope {OTHER_pronoun} keeps at it, wherever {OTHER_pronoun} is.
[timeout] {OTHER_nameDef} has lost interest, or I've lost patience. Either way the lessons have stopped.
Maybe what I know isn't meant to be passed on. Maybe it stops with me.

warm.li: [timeout] I'll keep teaching anyone who wants to learn. The door's open.

cheerful.li: [timeout] The lessons have paused, but I've written it all down, in case anyone wants it.

gloomy.li: [timeout] Everything I know will go into the ground with me, the way it's going.

cold.li: [timeout] {OTHER_nameDef} isn't the right student. I'll choose more carefully next time.

fizzleChronicle.li: [otherdead] {PAWN_nameDef} lost {PAWN_possessive} student, {OTHER_nameDef}, before the lessons were done.
{PAWN_nameDef}'s lessons with {OTHER_nameDef} have come to an end, unfinished.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} taught me nearly everything {OTHER_pronoun} knew. Nearly. I'll work out the rest myself, and hear {OTHER_objective} every step of the way.
I still have {OTHER_nameDef}'s voice in my head when I work. "Slower," it says. "Again."
